nativeProducer.reuseReason: Unchanged ordinary compiler source corpus; new diagnostic module is source input compiled by this authenticated native producer.

contract.identityScope: Collision-free structural input identities plus context object token. Semantic equivalence, alpha equivalence and different context copies not quotiented. No memo/optimization implemented.

boundary.host: trusted C file/import loader and serial opaque native Run chunk driver
boundary.sourceAlgorithms: unchanged canonical Bend parser/expansion/checker/JS library emitter
boundary.parserFuelRepresentation: eager native 8M-cell chain per source; JS harness uses lazy cells for the same finite fuel; allocation time remains included in parse
boundary.fuelMemoryEvidence: per-source native process RSS high-water before/after allocation (not isolated live-byte attribution); guardian samples whole-tree RSS and physical footprint including fuel

identity.exactWithin: Complete structural arguments plus context object identity and context structure; counted classified observations only.
identity.context: Object identity is conservative: distinct query counts upper-bound structurally scoped argument classes across context copies; repeats prove equality within the observed context identity.
identity.structure: Full qualified tags and all own-data fields; array/list order, duplicates, Base.Map tree structure, semantic closure bodies/environments and binder levels retained. No declaration authority is rewritten.
identity.numbers: Nonnegative safe integer numbers and equal bigint values share Nat identity. Unsafe, fractional, negative and negative-zero numbers are unsupported.
identity.immutability: Caller asserts all native Data and arrays remain immutable; weak memoization relies on that contract.

limitations: Caller-supplied provenance is preserved, not independently authenticated by this module.
No evaluation, normalization, quotation, NF idempotence, cache safety or absence of additional semantic sharing is established.
Few exact repeats cannot refute semantic or subexpression sharing: unused environment entries, alpha equivalence and context copies are deliberately not quotiented out.
Omitting context, fuel, env, level, descriptor, target or seen is a diagnostic projection only. Reach seen remains ordered and target participates in exact identity.
Different Base.Map tree shapes and list-versus-array encodings remain conservatively distinct; unknown object representations are unsupported, never stringified.
Unsupported observations are excluded. Exact totals describe the classified subset; fullyClassifiedPrefix stops at the first unsupported or censored observation.
Any cap permanently stops classification, including known repeats. Partial intern/cache entries may remain but never increase classified/distinct counts.

Byte accounting bounds retained signature payloads and charges per-entry overhead; it is not a JS heap/RSS measurement. Reflection can allocate one own-key array before its size is checked; the external resource guard remains required.
Weak-entry counts are cumulative insertions, not live retained native objects; no query or report holds native values strongly.
